title: CENTURY PRODUCTS: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT: INDEPENDENT (11,000 affected)
summary: THIS CHILD SAFETY SEAT UTILIZES A LATCH ASSEMBLY  WHERE A VARIATION IN THE COMPONENTS RESULTED IN THE POTENTIAL FOR A BUCKLE TO RELEASE. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE DYNAMIC TESTING REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 213.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/WHEELS:HUB (206 affected)
summary: THE FRONT WHEEL HUB CAN DEVELOP CRACKS AT THE WHEEL MOUNTING STUDS. WHEN MOUNTED TO THE HUB, THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE DISC ROTOR DOES NOT PROPERLY SUPPORT THE HUB AT THE WHEEL STUDS CAUSING EXCESSIVE STRESS AND FATIGUE CRACKS IN THE HUB.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS (220 affected)
summary: THE BOLTS USED TO MOUNT THE BRAKE ASSEMBLIES TO THE AXLES MAY HAVE CRACKS FROM IMPROPER HEAT TREATMENT.

title: EIS BRAKE PARTS: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (414 affected)
summary: THESE BRAKE HOSE ASSEMBLIES HAVE INADEQUATE CRIMPS ATTACHING THE HOSE TO THE HOSE FITTINGS AND COULD CAUSE THE HOSE AND FITTING TO SEPARATE.

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: CARPENTER/STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR (20,950 affected)
summary: PASSENGERS' CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES (15,122 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH ONE OR MORE INCORRECT SAFETY BELT AND/OR SAFETY BELT BUCKLE ENDS. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT (49,000 affected)
summary: THE RIVETS HOLDING THE REAR OUTBOARD BELT D-RINGS WERE NOT HEAT TREATED PROPERLY CAUSING THE HEADS OF THE RIVETS TO FRACTURE UNDER LOAD AND FAIL TO HOLD THE D-RINGS TO THE STRAPS. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: IC CORPORATION: AMTRAN/STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR (5,800 affected)
summary: PASSENGER'S CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: Shyft Group: SPARTAN/ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING (160 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRICAL HARNESS POWER DISTRIBUTION CENTER WAS MOUNTED BEHIND THE KICK PANEL IN THE STEP WELL AREA OF THE TRUCK, AND THE UNSEALED CONNECTORS, IF EXPOSED TO WATER, COULD RESULT IN STRAY VOLTAGE, SHORTING, OR CORROSION.

title: IC CORPORATION: AMTRAN/STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR (2,650 affected)
summary: PASSENGER'S CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: IC CORPORATION: AMTRAN/STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR (34,900 affected)
summary: PASSENGER'S CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: Land Rover: LAND ROVER/SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:CONTROL ARM (1,505 affected)
summary: THE REAR RADIUS ARM, WHICH LOCATES THE REAR AXLE, CAN FAIL AT THE EXTRUDED ALUMINUM CHASSIS EYE END.

title: AM GENERAL LLC: AM GENERAL/FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (3,000 affected)
summary: THE COATING USED TO PROTECT THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL SHAFT IS INCOMPATIBLE WITH THE BRONZE BUSHING THROUGH WHICH THE SHAFT PASSES. OVER TIME, AND IN THE PRESENCE OF A CORROSIVE ENVIRONMENT (WATER, ROAD SALT), THE SHAFT CAN CORRODE INSIDE THE BUSHING INCREASING THE AMOUNT OF FRICTION BETWEEN THE ROTATING SHAFT AND THE STATIONARY BUSHING.

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: CARPENTER/EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (4,361 affected)
summary: PASSENGER'S CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (17,600 affected)
HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: HOLIDAY RAMBLER/EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (148 affected)
summary: THE AWNING ATTACHED FOR THE SLIDE-OUT ROOM CAN UNFURL OR UNROLL DURING TRANSIT CAUSING THE BRACKET TO RIP FREE OF THE SIDEWALL.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES (698 affected)
summary: THESE TIRES MAY NOT COMPLETE THE REQUIRED HIGH SPEED WHEEL TEST MILEAGE FOR TIRES MOLDED WITH A UTQG TEMPERATURE GRADE OF "A".

title: Roadmaster, LLC: ROADMASTER/EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES (1,289 affected)
summary: THE QUICK DISCONNECT IS SUBJECT TO METAL FATIGUE AROUND THE BOLT HOLES.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO TRUCK/BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS (771 affected)
summary: THE TRACTION SOLENOID EXHAUST CAN BE OBSTRUCTED DUE TO INADEQUATE DRAINAGE AND A BUILD-UP OF ROAD CONTAMINATION BETWEEN THE MOUNTING BRACKET AND THE SOLENOID HOUSING. THE OBSTRUCTED EXHAUST PREVENTS THE RELAY VALVE CONTROL AIR PRESSURE FROM VENTING AFTER A DIFFERENTIAL BRAKING TRACTION EVENT.

title: VEHICLE SAFETY SYSTEMS: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS (2,400 affected)
summary: THE SEAT RECLINER TO SEAT FRAME ATTACHING BOLTS ON THESE VEHICLES COULD LOOSEN, FATIGUE AND FRACTURE, ALLOWING THE SEAT BACK TO SUDDENLY RECLINE.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR (4,500 affected)
summary: PASSENGER'S CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: WESTERN STAR/BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS (12 affected)
summary: THESE TRUCKS WERE NOT BUILT WITH INVERSION VALVES DUE TO A PROGRAMMING ERROR. THE INVERSION VALVE PROVIDES MODULATED SPRING BRAKE APPLICATION DURING EMERGENCY BRAKING WHEN THE "A" PORTION OF THE AIR BRAKE SYSTEM HAS FAILED.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: FREIGHTLINER/STEERING:GEAR:RACK AND PINION (2,283 affected)
summary: (1) THE MOUNTING PLATE, WHICH IS USED IN COMBINATION WITH FOUR BOLTS TO SECURE THE SAGINAW 710 STEERING GEAR TO THE CHASSIS FRAME, WAS DESIGNED TO HAVE FOUR WELDED BOSSES WITH THE SAME FINAL HEIGHT DIMENSION. THIS PLATE WAS NOT GROUND DOWN; (2) PAINT WAS LEFT ON THE SURFACE BETWEEN THE MOUNTING PLATE AND THE STEERING GEAR; (3) A FLANGED-HEAD BOLT WAS MISALIGNED THROUGH THE FRAME, MOUNTING PLATE AND THE STEERING GEAR; OR (4) THE TOLERANCES BETWEEN THE FRAME AND THE MOUNTING PLATE HOLES WERE TOO TIGHT CAUSING AN ALIGNMENT PROBLEM DURING ASSEMBLY.

title: Shyft Group: SPARTAN/ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (52 affected)
summary: THE FAN CLUTCH FOR THE ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM FAN WAS COMBINED WITH AN INAPPROPRIATE FAN, WHICH INTERFERES WITH THE DRIVE AND CAN CAUSE THE DRIVE TO SEPARATE.
